parts.text: Sulfuric acid is manufactured by an industrial process. Sulfur is obtained from sulfur-containing metal ores. The sulfur in the metal ore is converted to sulfur dioxide which is then oxidised to sulfur trioxide as shown. 2SO 2 (g) + O 2 (g) 2SO 3 (g)

ms.label: 3(b)
ms.text: strong heating in air / roasting in air

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) The reaction that produces sulfur trioxide is an equilibrium. The forward reaction is exothermic.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) State the temperature and pressure used to make sulfur trioxide. temperature = .............................. ° C pressure = .............................. atm [2]

ms.label: 3(d)(iii)
ms.text:
M1 the rate of forward reaction equals (the rate of the) reverse reaction (1)
M2 concentrations of reactants and products are constant (1)

ms.label: 3(d)(iv)
ms.text:
increased temperature:
M1 (position of) equilibrium moves to left-hand side (1)
M2 reaction is exothermic (1)
increased pressure:
M3 (position of) equilibrium moves to right-hand side (1)
M4 more (gaseous) moles / molecules on left-hand side (1)

ms.label: 3(d)(v)
ms.text:
M1 rate increases and particles have more energy (1)
M2 more collisions (between particles) occur per second / per unit time (1)
M3 more of the particles / collisions have energy equal to or above the activation energy (1)
